messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added **Deal name** inside **Reproduce a game**. The name now saves with your progress and returns when loaded.

Fixed pasted saves being rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Older saves and replays remain compatible.

Passed: build, type checking, 146 unit/static tests and all 80 browser tests. Changed files pass formatting; repository-wide formatting still flags existing issues in unchanged files.
